title: Deliver deploy events to subscribers that change while they listen

blocks.text: The deploy notifier tells billing, search, the audit trail and a few others that a new version went out. They subscribe at startup and hardly ever after, while deploy events arrive all day from several threads. Two new subscribers change the list from inside a delivery: a one-shot reminder unsubscribes itself after its first deploy, and the canary watcher subscribes the full-rollout watcher once the canary passes.

items: `newSubscribers()`: the list that holds the subscribers;
`deploy(event)`: delivers the event to every subscriber that was subscribed when the call began, in the order they subscribed, and returns how many it delivered to.

blocks.text: A subscriber added during a delivery hears from the next deploy on; one removed during a delivery still hears the deploy in progress. About five lines in total. The tests use one thread.

cases.says: every subscriber hears every deploy, in the order they subscribed, and deploy reports how many heard it
a subscriber unsubscribed between two deploys hears only the first
a subscriber that unsubscribes itself while it handles a deploy neither breaks the delivery nor makes another subscriber miss it
a subscriber added while a deploy is delivered hears from the next deploy on, not the one in progress
a subscriber that was subscribed when a deploy began hears it, even if another subscriber unsubscribes it during the delivery

origin.section: CopyOnWriteArrayList Copies Its Array on Every Write, So Readers Iterate a Snapshot

concepts: A CopyOnWriteArrayList iterator works over the array as it was when iteration began: it never throws ConcurrentModificationException, and changes made during the loop show from the next iteration.
